abstract: The first pregnancy established after subzonal insertion of frozen-thawed sperm obtained from a patient with seminoma and severe oligoasthenospermia is reported. A total of 800,000 sperm with a poor progressive motility were recovered after thawing. Three to seven motile spermatozoa were injected into the perivitelline space of each of 10 oocytes, and seven sibling oocytes were coincubated and inseminated with 200,000 motile sperm/mL. Only 1 of the manipulated oocytes fertilized and was transferred to the uterus 65 hours after insemination at the eight-cell stage. A healthy boy weighing 3,600 g was delivered spontaneously at 38 weeks of pregnancy. This report gives hope to patients with testicular malignancy and severely impaired sperm function to maintain their reproductive potential through sperm banking and assisted fertilization techniques.
abstract_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者から採取し凍結融解した精子について、重度の乏精子無力症を伴う症例で、卵子囲卵腔下挿入による妊娠が成立した最初の報告である。融解後に回収された精子は総数80万個で、運動性は低かった。運動性のある精子3〜7個を10個の卵子の卵黄周囲腔に注入し、残りの7個の姉妹卵子は共培養の上、20万個/mLの運動性精子で受精させた。操作した卵子のうち1個のみが受精し、受精後65時間に8細胞期で子宮に移植された。妊娠38週に自然分娩で体重3,600gの健康な男児が出生した。本報告は、精子バンキングと補助的受精技術により、精巣悪性腫瘍で精子機能が著しく低下した患者が生殖能力を維持できる可能性への希望を与えるものである。
